title: Riesz representation theorem, vector-valued (Simon 4.14, with 4.7, 4.10)
statement: For every locally compact Hausdorff space X, finite-dimensional real inner product space H, and linear L : C_c(X; H) → ℝ that is bounded above on {f : |f| ≤ 1, spt f ⊆ K} for each compact K, there are a Radon outer measure μ on X and a μ-measurable ν : X → H with |ν| = 1 μ-a.e. and L(f) = ∫_X ⟨f, ν⟩ dμ for all f ∈ C_c(X; H).
